description: Deployed full-stack AI-Assisted CRMs using React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, and MongoDB, implementing a scalable layered backend and JWT-based Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
Integrated AI-driven message processing workflows to classify customer intent, generate structured JSON reply drafts, and automate human escalation routing via mock WhatsApp webhooks.
Optimized database performance and data integrity by designing targeted MongoDB indexes and enforcing strict event idempotency to prevent duplicate webhook processing for scalable lead tracking.
